dictation.reason: Persist the former compatibility order as an explicit profile. FluidAudio led strict WER on synthetic fixtures, but natural and code-switched human speech is still an adoption gate.

meeting.reason: Use local VAD as an optional fail-open gate while retaining the established transcription order until streaming and speaker fixtures pass.

listening.reason: Use local VAD as an optional fail-open gate and preserve the existing local-first transcription behavior.

hands_free.reason: The local cascaded profile is the preview default, but availability gating and the physical echo/barge-in release gate prevent unsupported activation.
